summary: Interview with Marcus Belander from Stockpix who discusses value investing strategy focused on Nordic small caps with low PE ratios. He is cautious about the current bear market rally, suggesting markets may fall further. Key investment themes include professionalization of used car market, Finnish banking consolidation, and asset-light construction companies.

Stockpix focuses on Nordic small caps with quality track records and low valuations
